The Company intends to complete a first tranche of the FT Offering on or about November 27, 2026, consisting of approximately 3,846,154 FT Shares for gross proceeds of approximately $500,000. The Company intends to complete a second tranche of the FT Offering for the balance of the FT Shares thereafter.

The revised purchase price and corresponding increase in the maximum number of FT Shares issuable under the FT Offering are the only changes to the terms of the FT Offering. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. For further details regarding the FT Offering, please refer to the Company's news releases dated September 2, 2026 and October 13, 2026.
The Company has also extended the deadline for completion of its previously announced non-brokered private placement of up to 1,666,666 units of the Company (each, a "
Unit
") at a purchase price of $0.12 per Unit for aggregate gross proceeds of up to $200,000 (the "
Unit Offering
"). All other terms and conditions of the Unit Offering remain unchanged. For further details regarding the Unit Offering, please refer to the Company's news release dated October 13, 2026.
Completion of the FT Offering and the Unit Offering remains subject to applicable regulatory approvals.

About Freedom Gold Corp.

Freedom Gold Corp. is a leading exploration and development company focused on unlocking the vast potential of gold resources. With a strategic approach to resource management and a commitment to sustainable practices, Freedom is dedicated to driving innovation and delivering value for its stakeholders. Founded in 2020, its mineral properties are located in Quebec and Nova Scotia, regions renowned for its rich deposits of these valuable resources.
